articles.title: Philly-based AI medical analysis start-up to be acquired for up to $270 million
articles.description: Healthcare-analysis giant Agilent Technologies is buying Proscia to speed its AI-based pathology records search and analysis.
articles.content:
Agilent Technologies Inc., a California-based lab equipment maker, says it has agreed to pay $240 million cash for Proscia, a 10-year-old, Philadelphia-based developer of AI-based pathology-records search and diagnosis systems.
